title: alyssum montanum var. numidicum
intro: Alyssum montanum var. numidicum, commonly known as Mountain Sweet Alyssum, is a flowering plant species belonging to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fighting against infections, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Sweet Alyssum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential therapeutic uses. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
